description: Gets play stats, usage or a quality score for one workout, program or exercise. Use when the user asks how a workout performs, where an item is used before deleting it, or how to improve its quality. Not for team-wide analytics (use get_content_analytics). Returns stats (workouts), usage (workouts, exercises) or a 0–100 quality score with fixes (workouts, programs).

id.description: ID of the workout, program or exercise. Get it from list_team_workouts, list_team_programs or list_team_exercises.

period.description: Time window for report=stats: 24h, 7d, 30d, 90d, 180d or all_time. Defaults to "all_time".

report.description: Which insight: stats = member plays, completions, ratings (workouts only); usage = which programs or workouts use it (workouts, exercises); quality = 0–100 quality score with fixes (workouts, programs).

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

type.description: What the ID points to: workout, program, or exercise (a team exercise video).

name: get_content_insights
title: Get content insights
